_comment: Initial brand registry. Loaded into the database once, on first run. After that, manage sources from the Brands page or the /api/sources endpoints — no code changes needed. 'assessment' records what was verified on 2026-10-16. Baaori was removed at the user's request on 2026-10-16.

sources.name: Just Pals
sources.assessment: Shopify. /products.json public (16 products). Prices, images, links, published_at available.

sources.name: Sundazed
sources.assessment: Shopify. /products.json public (42 products); /collections.json exposes collection publish dates.

sources.name: SRVDCOLD
sources.assessment: Instagram profile. Not scraped (Instagram terms; no permitted public product feed). Products can be added manually. srvdcold.com exists but returns HTTP 402 (store unavailable) and is not verified as the same brand.

sources.name: Korakagaz India
sources.assessment: Shopify. /products.json public (97 products). product_type empty — categories inferred from tags/title.

sources.name: The ROK
sources.assessment: WordPress + WooCommerce. Public Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products (511 products, INR). No publish dates exposed — recency uses first-seen only.
